### First Horizon Bank Names Elizabeth Adler Treasury Management Sales Officer for New Orleans


November 9, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s21.q4cdn.com/903615748/files/doc_news/First-Horizon-Bank-Names-Elizabeth-Adler-Treasury-Management-Sales-Officer-for-New-Orleans-2026.pdf)


NEW ORLEANS


, Nov. 9, 2026


/PRNewswire/ -- First Horizon Bank (NYSE: FHN or "First Horizon") has named Elizabeth Adler Treasury Management Sales Officer for the New Orleans market.


"We are excited to have Elizabeth on the Treasury Management Sales team in New Orleans," said Tony Adams, Gulf States Regional President for First Horizon Bank. "Her commitment to building strong relationships and delivering exceptional service will enhance how we serve our clients and communities across the region."


"Elizabeth has a strong understanding of the financial needs of businesses within this market and knows how to translate those needs into customized solutions," said Marcy Sasser, Senior Vice President of Treasury Management for Louisiana at First Horizon Bank. "Her collaborative approach and dedication to service excellence are an ideal fit for this role."


Adler brings more than 30 years of banking and financial services experience to her new role. She joined First Horizon in September 2025 and is actively involved in the New Orleans community, serving in leadership roles with local organizations.


**About First Horizon**
First Horizon Corp. (NYSE: FHN), with $84.3 billion in assets as of September 30, 2026, is a leading regional financial services company, dedicated to helping our clients, communities and associates unlock their full potential with capital and counsel. Headquartered in Memphis, TN, the banking subsidiary First Horizon Bank operates in 12 states concentrated in the southern U.S. The Company and its subsidiaries offer commercial, private banking, consumer, small business, wealth and trust management, retail brokerage, capital markets, fixed income, and mortgage banking services. First Horizon has been recognized as one of the nation's best employers by Fortune and Forbes magazines and a Top 10 Most Reputable U.S. Bank. More information is available at[www.FirstHorizon.com](http://www.firsthorizon.com/) .
